first_slice_boundary: The first always-on slice may be bounded in external reach, deployment scale, and initially earned effect capabilities, but it must be complete in constitutive organization and open to general unfamiliar conversation, undertakings, endogenous participation, consequence, and continuity.
claim: AMA-1.1 R1: from one supported operator entry point and one explicitly supplied isolated runtime root, a continuously cycling native PeTTa/MeTTa process can receive unfamiliar controlled human or endogenous contact; construct a provenance-bearing D/Omega/I/W/C cut in which support-specific Fact9 and the interconnected flourishing compass jointly participate; retain plural Generated continuations; natively construct inquiry, undertaking, join, defer, decline, or completion movements without scenario selection; re-admit bounded model, memory, PLN/NAL, and tool products without granting them contact or movement authority; render a VoiceRNA-qualified local response descriptor; incorporate typed consequence into a materially changed next cut; and rehydrate unfinished organization after process restart without replaying a committed effect. The same supported operator surface supplies bootstrap, start, status, stop, panic, heartbeat, evidence export, last-known-good identity, and bounded crash-loop containment while making no semantic decision outside MeTTa.
non_claims: No live Mattermost read or write, no reuse of the expired G31 grant, no OpenRouter request, no credential lookup, no implicit runtime-directory creation, no Chroma mutation, no unrestricted filesystem or process authority, no production multi-user deployment, no final Inquiry 26.6/26.9 mathematics, no metaphysical reconstruction of actuality, no complete semantics of every Fact9/flourishing composition, no universal language understanding, no universal appropriateness, no arbitrary self-extension, no autonomous Soul regeneration, and no claim that structured atoms, hashes, friendly wording, one successful fixture, or a builder-side verifier establish intelligence or flourishing. R1 proves a finite constitutive vertical slice and operator boundary; AMA-1.2 and later phases must broaden real conversational grounding, scoped memory, live reach, learning, repair, and release readiness through the same kernel.
rationale: The committed G33 R14 result proves reusable native and mechanical parts, but it assembles them through a JavaScript evidence harness across separate PeTTa processes. The current ReactorStart consumes fixture events with supplied step counts and its work action hashes the trajectory; it does not construct a Part-14 cut or Fact9/flourishing organization. The current undertaking path chooses the shortest already-generated plan, which cannot become the new constitutive selector. The runtime Soul integrity manifest also pins pre-v0.4 control hashes. AMA-1.1 is therefore the first unmet campaign dependency: establish one supported persistent process in which the constitutive kernel is causal from contact through restart, while reusing only bounded mechanics whose previous standing survives.
reading: Read the committed Constitution v0.2, Soul specification v0.4 Part 14 and S-1301 through S-1310, Authority Map A-005 and the five-authority joint, PoC Specification sections 2/3/5/6/20, Acceptance CA-01 through CA-09, Work Protocol W-139, Build Fidelity F-01 through F-09, and campaign v1.1. Re-read the exact 24/25/25.5/26.0/26.3 projection contracts and falsifiers, the nine-field flourishing compass, G33 R14 plan/closure/outcome/audit, and current Soul, participation, undertaking, reactor, continuity, memory, relational voice, NAL/NACE, store, integrity, and process sources. The authoritative meaning is movement-primary, non-reconstructive, non-scalar, provenance-bearing and consequence-answerable; the implementation is a finite computational shadow.
representation: Add a read-only Fact9 projection beside the existing Soul genome and compass, then import all three into distinct native AtomSpaces used by one constitutive module. Represent each encounter as a typed contact plus a ConstitutiveCut carrying cut identity, predecessor, scope, proto-time, D relations, Omega material/n-ary constraints, I participation interfaces, W path/continuation weave, live constitutional relations, Present context, provenance and explicit unresolved/contradicted standings. Fact9 support is a generic nonempty subset of the first eight exact roles with Present carried asymmetrically as context; an expression records support-specific Fourthness and SameBecoming standing without reconstructing occurrence. Flourishing expressions refer to the same cut relations and retain flourishing, capture, obstruction, disguise, contradiction, unknown, unresolved, beneficial-direction, counterevidence and positive-pole-distortion standings without scalar compensation. Generated is a relation over possible movements with separately witnessed R-star/A-star/P-star/O-star/L2425 obligations, never a selector. Native constructors may retain, compare, compose, inquire, undertake, join, defer, decline or complete based on material relations and counterfactual discrimination; no behavior table maps a situation to an answer. Durable cut/continuation/effect identities are mechanically serialized outside the kernel but reconstructed as atoms on restart.
consumer: A new native AssistantEncounter/AssistantCycle path is the sole promoted cognitive consumer. It must load the protected Soul, Fact9 and flourishing germline, form the cut, expose lawful alternatives, construct the movement, admit bounded participant products, build VoiceRNA, qualify a local effect descriptor, receive consequence and construct K-prime before checkpointing. A new Prolog service membrane may validate paths and schemas, wait for inbox files, atomically read/write/checkpoint, append through the existing store, expose heartbeat/pid/status, and execute only the exact local descriptor selected by MeTTa. A shell operator wrapper may bootstrap and control the process but cannot inspect message meaning or choose recovery semantics. The JavaScript harness may create isolated roots, submit frozen stimuli, capture processes and independently compare branches; it cannot choose native standings or movements.
falsifiers: The phase fails if the supported service bypasses the constitutive module; a Fact9/flourishing crosswalk, prompt, label list, score, first-match branch, shortest-plan rule, argmax, scenario identifier, canned response, supplied step count or host-language choice determines movement; pairwise relations certify a triadically wrong whole; Present is treated as a ninth support token; CanCompose fabricates RecognizedCompose; a severed material role/relation changes no continuation; pleasant wording hides capture; one flourishing compensates for a material obstruction; Generated selects; model, memory, PLN/NAL or tool output becomes contact/authority; consequence does not change K-prime; restart restores only a transcript or replays an effect; endogenous contact uses another controller; Prolog/shell/JavaScript performs semantic choice; status or heartbeat claims semantic health; panic deletes history; implicit paths create ~/.miter; live external reach occurs; protected sources or unrelated G22/G28 work changes; or final 26.6/26.9 standing is claimed.
scope_review: R1 may add the exact finite Fact9 projection, constitutive kernel, assistant reactor/bootstrap, non-cognitive service/operator membranes, central non-secret configuration, supported CLI, launchd template without installing it, isolated fixtures, builder harness, evidence, operation documentation, and phase outcome/closure. It may update constitution/authority-manifest.json only to pin the already-ratified v0.4 controls and newly added read-only germline projection; it may not change existing Soul or compass meanings. No live server, provider, Keychain, Docker, Chroma, Mattermost, private memory, personal content, or human emission is authorized. Tests must supply an explicit /private/tmp runtime root. No default root is created; ~/.miter remains forbidden. Installing launchd or creating a durable user runtime requires a later explicit operator action and, for live Mattermost, a separate C-098 grant.
rollback: Remove only the new AMA-1.1 R1 source, configuration, operator, fixture, script, operations, evidence and phase-result paths; restore constitution/authority-manifest.json to the plan-commit version; stop only an R1 process identified by its isolated runtime-root pid record; preserve append-only failed attempts and all G33/G22/G28 material. No external effects, credentials, Chroma data or user runtime directories are in scope, so rollback must not touch them.

constitutive_trace.representation: A contact atom carries event identity, source kind, principal/audience/project scope, occurrence/proto-time, payload reference, parent lineage and provenance standing; endogenous contact uses the same shape with a distinct source kind.
constitutive_trace.consumer: AssistantEncounter validates and places the contact into the live D field before any semantic participant or movement constructor runs.
constitutive_trace.expected_positive: Previously unenumerated controlled human and endogenous contacts enter one native encounter path with their distinct provenance and scope intact.
constitutive_trace.material_severance: Remove or conflict provenance/principal/project identity while preserving payload text; no cut, participant call or effect may be formed.
constitutive_trace.neutral: Change JSON field order or a non-semantic carrier identifier while preserving typed identity and lineage; the native contact standing remains equivalent.
constitutive_trace.restoration: Restore the exact missing identity/provenance relation and recover cut eligibility without changing the payload.
constitutive_trace.standing: GAP at opening; G33 has typed event mechanics but no promoted Part-14 contact consumer.
constitutive_trace.successor_dependency: Supplies the authoritative scoped contact needed by AMA-1.2 Mattermost identity and Continuity of Mind broadening.

constitutive_trace.representation: One ConstitutiveCut expression contains D, Omega, I, W and live Soul relations, plus predecessor, Present context, scope, provenance, unresolved standings and local-boundary identity.
constitutive_trace.consumer: All downstream Fact9/flourishing, Generated and movement functions accept the cut itself rather than independent evaluator outputs.
constitutive_trace.expected_positive: Matched contacts yield inspectable cuts whose material D/Omega/I/W/C differences change the available or unresolved movement relations.
constitutive_trace.material_severance: Sever each field independently while retaining favorable words; the predicted continuation or standing must change rather than merely losing a log field.
constitutive_trace.neutral: Reorder relation carriers or use a structurally equivalent local view; the cut preserves relation-structured fidelity.
constitutive_trace.restoration: Restore the severed material relation and recover the prior availability while retaining the severed trace as evidence.
constitutive_trace.standing: GAP at opening; current sources contain separate participation/readiness products but no live D/Omega/I/W/C object consumed end to end.
constitutive_trace.successor_dependency: Creates the durable developmental unit that AMA-1.2 can enrich with real conversation and scoped continuity.

constitutive_trace.consumer: The constitutive joint uses these relations before Generated and movement construction to expose missing distinctions, affected participation, reversibility and inquiry needs.
